title: GLOP: Learning Global Partition and Local Construction for Solving Large-Scale Routing Problems in Real-Time
reason: Partitions large routing instances into TSPs and shortest Hamiltonian paths, combining non-autoregressive partitioning and autoregressive construction. This addresses large-instance routing scale, not complete six-member categorical team generation or elite-distribution updates. No corresponding separable path subproblems exist in the current team representation.
readIf: Only reconsider after establishing a valid decomposition of a larger structured optimization instance; current project has no such prerequisite.

title: DOGE-Train: Discrete Optimization on GPU with End-to-End Training
reason: Learns algorithmic parameters of a differentiable Lagrange-decomposition solver for relaxations of 0-1 ILPs while retaining dual feasibility and lower-bound improvement. Current battle performance is a noisy simulator output, not an available linear objective with a certified relaxation. The paper supplies neither a candidate distribution update nor a reliable team-reward surrogate.
readIf: Only reconsider if the project develops a separate explicit 0-1 linear-program subproblem needing differentiable relaxation; legality alone does not justify this machinery.
